title: Normalized monomial blowup charts and their transition maps
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $P$ a fine commutative monoid with torsion-free group completion $G$, and $I\subseteq P$ an ideal generated by a finite nonempty set $E$ [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup]. Put $J=k[I]\subseteq k[P]$. For $a\in E$, let $C_a=P[I-a]\subseteq G$ be the monoid generated by $P$ and all $b-a$, $b\in I$ [def-trf-monoscheme-toric-realization]. The $a$-chart of $\operatorname{Bl}_J(\operatorname{Spec}k[P])$ has ring $k[P][J/e^a]=k[C_a]$ inside $\operatorname{Frac}(k[G])$, and its normalization in that field is $k[C_a^{\rm sat}]$. The monoids $C_a$ and $C_a^{\rm sat}$ are fine with torsion-free group completion $G$.

For $a,b\in E$ their chart overlap maps are the monomial identifications obtained by inverting $e^{b-a}$ in the $a$-chart and $e^{a-b}$ in the $b$-chart, before and after normalization. All these identifications commute with restriction $P\to P[c^{-1}]$, $c\in P$, with the ideal extended. Each comparison is over $\operatorname{Spec}k[P]$, respects the coaction $e^g\mapsto e^g\otimes e^g$, and becomes the identity of $\operatorname{Spec}k[G]$ after inverting all monomials. Thus the normalized blowup has this finite chart cover with its specified transition maps.

source.place: VIII 3.1.17--3.1.21, Lemmas 3.2.9, 3.2.17 and Corollary 3.2.18, pp.101,104--105; overlap formulas expanded by an agent.

proof.text: Choose a finite generating set $S$ of $P$. Since $I=E+P$, every $b\in I$ is $e+p$ with $e\in E$, $p\in P$, and $b-a=(e-a)+p$. Thus $C_a$ is generated by the finite set $S\cup\{e-a:e\in E\}$. It embeds in $G$, so it is integral. Moreover $P\subseteq C_a\subseteq G$ and $P$ generates $G$ as a group, so the subgroup generated by $C_a$ is exactly $G$. These observations give fineness and the asserted torsion-free group completion for $C_a$.

source.place: VIII 3.1.19--3.1.20, p.101; additive expansion of the ideal-fraction chart.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-fine-monoid-finite-saturation] to each $C_a$: its saturation is fine and has the same group completion $G$. Apply [lem-trf-affine-monoid-algebra-normalization] both to $P$ and to $C_a$. Their monoid algebras embed in $k[G]$ and have fraction field $K=\operatorname{Frac}(k[G])$. The latter application identifies the integral closure of $k[C_a]$ in $K$ with $k[C_a^{\rm sat}]$. All hypotheses hold by Step 1; saturation is taken in this same $G$.

source.place: VIII 3.1.17 and Lemma 3.2.9, pp.101,104; applied to the finitely generated integral chart monoids.

proof.text: The monomials $e^a$ for $a\in E$ generate $J$: every $e^b$ with $b=e+p\in I$ equals $e^e e^p$. By [prop-nagata-affine-blowup-chart-cover] these give a finite affine open cover of the blowup. Its chart algebra is the subalgebra generated by $k[P]$ and $x/e^a$, $x\in J$, as in [def-trf-monoscheme-toric-realization]. Inside $K$, each such fraction is a finite $k$-linear sum of $e^{b-a}$ with $b\in I$. Conversely every such monomial is $e^b/e^a$ and is a chart generator. Products add exponents, so this subalgebra is exactly $k[C_a]$. The equality fixes every $e^p$ for $p\in P$, hence is over $\operatorname{Spec}k[P]$.

source.place: VIII Lemma 3.2.17, proof, p.105; affine blowup cover also Stacks Tag 0804 (lemma-blowing-up-affine), divisors.tex.

proof.text: Use the Rees presentation of the blowup [def-nagata-affine-blowup, def-nagata-rees-algebra]. Put $f_a=e^a t$ and $f_b=e^b t$, both homogeneous of degree one. Under the fraction chart description [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], $f_b/f_a=e^{b-a}$. Thus the overlap indexed by $f_af_b$ is the principal localization of the $a$-chart at $e^{b-a}$ and of the $b$-chart at $e^{a-b}$. Its canonical maps are the localization equivalences of [lemma-nagata-proj-chart-ring-cocycle]. Explicitly the two exponent monoids coincide: $C_a+\mathbf N(a-b)=C_b+\mathbf N(b-a)$, since $u-b=(u-a)+(a-b)$ and $u-a=(u-b)+(b-a)$ for $u\in I$. Both rings therefore equal the subring generated by the same monomials in $K$; the overlap sends each $e^g$ to itself. The cited cocycle supplies the identity, inverse and triple-overlap equations for the actual blowup charts.

source.place: VIII 3.1.19 and 3.2.17, pp.101,105, overlap calculation expanded by an agent; standard Proj localizations: Stacks Tag 01M4 (lemma-standard-open), constructions.tex.

proof.text: Normalize the affine charts in the common field $K$, using the meaning of normalized blowup in [def-trf-monoscheme-toric-realization]. By Step 2 the new rings are $k[C_a^{\rm sat}]$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-integral-closure-commutes-localization] with $A=k[C_a]$, $B=K$ and the powers of $e^{b-a}$: since this monomial is nonzero, its localization leaves $K$ unchanged. Thus the normalization over the old overlap is exactly $k[C_a^{\rm sat}][(e^{b-a})^{-1}]$. The other chart gives the same integral closure of the same overlap ring inside $K$. Equivalently [lem-trf-fine-monoid-finite-saturation] identifies these rings through the saturation of the common localized monoid in Step 4. Every map is the identity in $K$, so the cocycles persist. The affine inverse images of the finite old cover cover the normalization, giving precisely the claimed normalized chart cover and transitions.

source.place: Tag 0307 (lemma-integral-closure-localize), with the affine normalization construction; ILO VIII 3.1.17 and Corollary 3.2.18, pp.101,105.

proof.text: For restriction at $c\in P$, put $P_c=P-\mathbf N c$ and $I_c=I-\mathbf N c$; the images of $E$ still generate $I_c$. The new $a$-chart monoid is $P_c[I_c-a]=C_a-\mathbf N c$: its extra generators have form $(u-nc)-a=(u-a)-nc$, and the reverse inclusion follows from $P\subseteq P_c$ and $u\in I\subseteq I_c$. On monoid algebras, $k[Q-\mathbf N c]=k[Q][(e^c)^{-1}]$: every exponent is $q-nc$, and its monomial is $e^q/(e^c)^n$. Finite sums and multiplication verify this identity inside $K$. By [lem-trf-fine-monoid-finite-saturation], $(C_a-\mathbf N c)^{\rm sat}=C_a^{\rm sat}-\mathbf N c$. By [lem-weil-pbc-integral-closure-commutes-localization], these are also the normalized restricted chart rings. The maps in Steps 3--5 all fix $e^g$ inside $K$, including after adjoining $e^{-c}$ and the overlap denominators. Hence the comparisons for the restricted data coincide with restriction of the original comparisons on every chart and overlap.

source.place: VIII 3.1.17 and Lemma 3.2.17, final sentence, pp.101,105; Stacks Tag 0307 for normalization restriction.

proof.text: All chart inclusions, comparisons and transition maps above are inclusions or identities on exponent monomials in $K$, fixing $k[P]$. For the torus coaction of [def-trf-monoscheme-toric-realization], their compatibility is the equality $e^g\mapsto e^g\otimes e^g$ on each generator; on a localized generator $e^q/(e^h)^n$ it reads $e^{q-nh}\mapsto e^{q-nh}\otimes e^{q-nh}$. These monomials span the rings, so the equality holds on all sections. Finally, inverting the monomials of $P$ turns $P$, every $C_a$ and every $C_a^{\rm sat}$ into $G$: each $g\in G$ is $p-q$ with $p,q\in P$. All localized rings are therefore $k[G]$, and every comparison and transition becomes the identity. This proves equivariance, the comparison over the base and the identity on the original torus, with the finite normalized cover already established in Step 5.

source.place: VIII 3.2.4, 3.2.14--3.2.18, pp.103,105; explicit generator formulas for the coaction and dense torus.
